target_text: // bf16 operator== compares values. The test must see every stored bit.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

'Bit-exact comparison of two rows' restates the name same_bits and the to_bits loop in the body. The kept sentences are the one fact the code does not say: why operator== (a __bf16 float comparison, bf16.hpp lines 13 and 37-39) is not used.

Proposed:
```cpp
// bf16 operator== compares values. The test must see every stored bit.
```
